subject: Blocked: AC-3 unmeetable — 5 tests RED at BASE a58bf71a (STAB fallout, not U-CHAIN)
body: U-CHAIN build is complete and green on every criterion it owns, but AC-3 ('full test suite green at head') cannot be met by this unit and I did not touch it. python3 -m unittest discover -s tests: 1707 tests, 5 failures at head 315ad409 — and the SAME 5 at BASE a58bf71a in a throwaway worktree. Failing sets are byte-identical, so U-CHAIN adds no new red. Causes are this run's own STABILIZE commits: (1) 296f100b added docs/runs/2026-09-20-clean-sweep-tracker.md with no row in the run-archive index -> test_docs_navigation.TestDocsNavigation.test_run_archive_index_lists_every_report + test_run_archive_integrity_standard_matches_practice + ReleaseCutWalkthrough.test_next_release_preparation_cut_tag_and_provenance + ReleaseRehearsalIsolation.test_inherited_git_selection_cannot_mutate_another_repository; (2) 3833c88e left README.md off the wiring script's fixed point ('would wire README.md: img 15->15, picture blocks 10') -> test_wire_docs.WiringScriptAnchors.test_the_committed_docs_are_the_scripts_fixed_point. Fixing either means editing docs/runs/README.md and README.md — another unit's files, forbidden by my stop rule, so I stopped and did not touch them. Evidence: docs/reports/U-CHAIN/suite.txt (head) and prered-base.txt (base), both committed; manifest records AC-3 as addressed=false with the reason and a park entry. ASK: do you want (a) U-CHAIN reported succeeded with AC-3 parked as 'no new red', or (b) a follow-up unit dispatched for the index row + README rewire before this lands? I am reporting worker_done now under (a) so the dispatch settles; re-engage this terminal if you want (b).
